description: Engine evaluates verdicts against a five-member frozenset and raises StructuralVerificationError on un-evaluated or None verdicts.
Pure RFC 8785 serialization: UTF-16 code-unit key sorting, ECMAScript 7.1.12.1 numbers, input strings preserved as-is with no normalization inside the canonicalizer (RFC 8785 Section 3.1).
Opt-in recursive NFC normalization for callers that need canonically equivalent inputs to converge on one digest; fails closed on key collisions; never invoked by encode_jcs.
COSE verifier delegates serialization to jcs_canonicalizer.encode_jcs, eliminating the previous code-point vs UTF-16 code-unit divergence from its inline json.dumps copy.
COSE signer updated in lockstep with the verifier so both sides of the signature pair share one canonicalization implementation.
25 tests covering RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3/3.2.4 byte vectors, Appendix B number samples, composition-exclusion preservation, and the opt-in NFC contract.
6 tests asserting byte-identical canonicalization across signer, verifier, and canonicalizer, plus sign/verify round-trip, stored-hash match, and tamper rejection.

Structural scaffolding that observes TCP socket state transitions at the kernel level per AGENTS.md Section 5; it makes no live kernel enforcement or packet-dropping claim, and disposition derivation stays at L7c in the AEIB engine.

Proposed receipt schema and compaction-safety marker for structural constraint retention across context compression; the verifier confirms it is still absent so this claim cannot silently overstate the release scope.
Ed25519 signing of canonicalized action envelopes via sign_trust_passport; matched pair with the verifier delegation.
Independent out-of-band probe keyed by idempotency_key that resolves dispatched-unconfirmed states; evaluated scope is local SQLite, not arbitrary provider topologies.
Reconciliation of receipts against authoritative state with SLA timeout, operating independently of the agent dispatch loop; eventual consistency via asynchronous queues.

Chaining AEIB receipts via prev_receipt_hash with RFC 6962 leaf hashes; not present in the AEIB receipt path. Merkle machinery currently exists only in the ocr-audit SCITT verifier and a Rust consensus crate, outside this pipeline.

Receipt schema pqc_status field and ML-DSA-65 epoch signing; no pqc_status field exists in any receipt schema and the Python signing path is Ed25519-only. The ml-dsa 0.1.1 crate is an evaluated dependency in Cargo.lock only.

Platform evidence schemas and external verifier integration for TDX/SEV-SNP quotes; not started. AGENTS.md Section 5 names a hardware_attestation directory as scaffolding, but no such directory exists in this workspace.

1:1 mapping for auditors: conceptual SUPPORTED_BY_EVIDENCE corresponds to OUTCOME_VERIFIED (out-of-band probe confirms atomic commit), and transport ambiguity freezes at PROBE_OUTAGE_HOLD with retry prohibited. Conceptual CLAIMED corresponds to DISPATCHED_UNCONFIRMED in src/aeib_v040_engine.py.

On ambiguous transport the engine freezes at DISPATCHED_UNCONFIRMED with retry_safe false and latch_engaged true (default fallback at line 518). The 500-episode chaos harness with seed 42 observed 0 duplicate mutations; that is a measured result under the stated synthetic fault model, not a universal property.

ERR_DISPOSITION_TOXIC (-6) is the fail-closed error code raised when a receipt carries a toxic (unconfirmed) disposition; also defined in src/ocr_audit/scitt_verifier.py. Distinct from the Layer 7c DISPATCHED_UNCONFIRMED latch in src/aeib_v040_engine.py.
